name: wordpress_jobs-jobs-mcp
description: WordPress.net Jobs (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: jobs.wordpress.net WordPress RSS 2.0 feed (10 latest job posts). s is WordPress's feed search (https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/wordpress-feeds/; checked 2026-09-25: ?s=developer narrows the feed) and paged selects older posts (a page past the end answers 404 -> invalid_input). location and limit are not sent. description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); the excerpt is raw.description and the post id raw['post-id']. id is the job permalink.
